_doc: On session start: load the todo list and remind the user to run /suggest-stack before starting a new project.

SessionStart.command: test -f .sylvain/todo.json && cat .sylvain/todo.json || echo '{"version":1,"tasks":[]}'; echo '\n💡 Tip: run /suggest-stack to verify the locked stack against the latest versions before starting a project.'
